notes.title: Christmas Giveaway - Get GNOMED!
notes.content:
Merry Christmas🎅🎄 everyone! Time for some free keys!🔑
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42379883/3280545ebbc6c40abb33b5793037a6ac55621c09.png
For this Christmas🎅 we have a special giveaway event!🎄
There are 31 Gnomes inside Disco Tomb(our steam demo) and each one will grant you 1 random Steam key!🎁

Make sure to download the DEMO and join our Discord in order to participate in the giveaway and find more info and rules about the event!

🤖 Discord link:🤖 https://discord.gg/2ASyACyARE
